Context length parameter (for tuning)

Source: R/parsnip.R
context_length.Rd

A dials parameter so context_length can be tuned with tune::tune_grid() over rsample resamples.

context_length(range = c(64L, 2048L), trans = NULL)

Arguments

range

Integer range of context lengths.

trans

A transformation, or NULL.

Value

A dials quantitative parameter.

Examples

context_length()
#> Context Length (quantitative)
#> Range: [64, 2048]

# Narrow the search space, then draw a grid from it.
dials::grid_regular(context_length(range = c(64L, 512L)), levels = 4)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 1
#>   context_length
#>            <int>
#> 1             64
#> 2            213
#> 3            362
#> 4            512
